question: Young person who goes to the emergency room for second degree flame burn of 10% of the body surface, affecting the right arm in an extensive and circular way. There is no arterial pulse in the hand measured by Doppler. What is the treatment of choice?

options.opa: Cures with occlusive silver sulfadiacin and evaluation of depth per week.
options.opb: Lymphatic drainage and assess a vascular by-pass.
